subject: Pricing follow-up: token economics & $/1M benchmarking
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + pricing next steps

Hi Sofia — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

Summary of needs:
- Primary use: customer-facing summarization and retrieval augmentation for Acme Help center (mixed short/long prompts).
- Expected steady-state: ~800M tokens/month initially, with burst to ~1.5B tokens during product launches.
- Latency target: p95 < 1.2s for 64-token responses.
- Compliance: SOC2 + regional data residency required (US).

Pricing/qualification asks we promised to confirm:
1) Target unit economics: what ACME expects for $/1M tokens (ballpark)?
2) Budget range for Q3/Q4 for inference spend?
3) Any procurement milestones (PO, procurement timeline, SSO/KMS requirements)?

Attachments: I've attached a draft pricing sheet and a benchmarking CSV that compares $/1M token ranges across OpenAI, Anthropic, and typical open-model hosts. Please review and confirm numbers or share a target $/1M so we can build a proposal and pilot plan.

Proposed next steps:
- You share target $/1M or budget range by end of week.
- We lock a 4-week pilot with throttled capacity and telemetry for unit-cost measurement.
- Follow-up call to review pilot metrics and finalize committed capacity/discounts.

Let me know if I missed anything. Thanks — talk soon.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0115

- 20260615-redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing draft)

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acme.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + pricing next steps

Thanks Vanessa — great session. Confirming numbers from our side: 
- Steady-state ~800M tokens/mo, with planned marketing-driven bursts up to ~1.5B tokens for ~2 weeks per quarter.
- Internal target for inference spend: $35k–$75k/mo in Q3 while we validate the feature; if the metrics look good we can expand.
- For procurement, we typically require: SOC2 Type II evidence, standard DPAs, and vendor KMS integration.

Target $/1M tokens: we're evaluating multiple vendors — internal benchmark target is ~$600–$900 / 1M tokens based on current estimates (OpenAI/Anthropic offers). If Redwood can get to the low end of that range with predictable performance, we'll prioritize you for the pilot.

Happy to set a follow-up next week to review a proposal.

—
Sofia Ramirez
Head of ML Product, Acme AI Solutions
sofia@acme.ai

P.S. Please include any assumptions around tokenization and average prompt+response length used for the benchmarking.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + pricing next steps

Thanks Sofia — really helpful. Below is a concise unit-economics view and our benchmarking note so you can compare apples-to-apples. I've also attached an updated pricing draft with a sample pilot structure.

Assumptions used (so numbers are comparable):
- Avg tokens per request = 384 (prompt 128 / response 256) — matches your expected usage pattern.
- Steady-state: 800M tokens/mo. Burst: 1.5B tokens for 2-week windows (modeled as 1.1B monthly equivalent for peak months).
- Model: Redwood-verified open-architecture LLM (quantized variant) for production inference; fallback to higher-cost variant during heavy tails.

Redwood unit economics (list prices, pre-discount):
- Baseline hosted: $1,200 / 1M tokens (public hosted list for our verified model suite).
- Typical open-model host spot rates: $900–$1,100 / 1M tokens depending on quantization and latency SLO.
- OpenAI (gpt-like managed): $1,800–$2,400 / 1M tokens depending on model and throughput tier.
- Anthropic: $1,600–$2,200 / 1M tokens depending on model.

Targeting for Acme (proposal guidance):
- Pilot (4 weeks, non-committed): $900 / 1M tokens — objective: measure real-world token mix and latency.
- Committed 6–12 month program (800M steady, burst to 1.5B): target $600–$750 / 1M tokens with reserved capacity + modest volume discounts.
- If Acme can commit to a monthly reserved commit (e.g., 800M tokens/mo) we can structure blended unit pricing to hit ~$600 / 1M tokens at scale and offer predictable latency SLOs + SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Notes on comparison: open-model hosts vary widely on kernel-level optimizations and whether KV prefix cache is charged; we normalize numbers to tokens consumed (prefix caching savings are modeled separately in the attached sheet). OpenAI/Anthropic numbers above reflect managed model convenience and SLA premium.

Next steps:
- If the $600–$750 / 1M target sounds reasonable, we'll draft a pilot SOW and reserved capacity options (including rollback/fallback policy) and route to procurement.
- I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up next Tue to walk the pilot SOW and the assumptions in the attached benchmarking sheet.

Attachments: 20260615-redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (updated) — includes pilot pricing rows and reserved commit tiers. 20260615-benchmarking-openai-anthropic.csv — normalized $/1M comparisons and assumptions.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0115
